J U D G M E N T
KURIAN, J.
1.
The  parties  approached  this  Court  with  certain
grievances  regarding  arbitration.  
 During  the
pendency of these appeals before this Court, it is
heartening to note that the parties have arrived at
an amicable settlement of the entire disputes.  They
have  also  filed  a  memorandum  of  settlement  dated
11.05.2017 along with I.A.No. 43908 OF 2017.
2.
Accordingly,  these  appeals  are  disposed  of  in
terms  of  the  memorandum  of  settlement  dated
11.05.2017.  The settlement shall form part of the
decree.
No costs.
